description: str_matches_regex_pat and str_matches_glob_captures use (String, bool) as the cache key in the thread-local LruCache. On every call, cache.get(&key) requires cloning the key string to construct the lookup value (since HashMap requires ownership on get, or the key must implement Borrow -- LruCache::get takes a reference so this may not clone, but cache.put(key.clone(), re) always clones). The regex pattern string can be hundreds of bytes for complex glob patterns. A small string-interning layer or using a hash of the pattern as the key would reduce allocations on the hot path. Impact: every header :regex or :matches test in a hot mail filter loop allocates and drops a String.
title: sieve: regex cache key includes full anchored pattern string; key clones on every hit
